rec.name: Homepage Hover-Expand Topic List (FAQ / Guide Teaser with Image Panel)
rec.status: Backlog — reference only (spec based on Samsung example; the referenced video was not available)

what.text: A homepage section with a headline, a large image panel on the left, and a numbered list of 5 FAQ or guide topics on the right. Hovering a topic expands it to show a short description and a 'Learn more' underlined link. The other topics stay collapsed as single-line titles, separated by thin divider lines. In the Samsung reference the section is headed 'Explore #DoWhatYouCant', and topic 05 is shown expanded with a short teaser and a 'Mehr erfahren' link.

why.text: It puts several helpful topics (buying guides, FAQs, how-tos) on the homepage without a wall of text. Progressive disclosure keeps the layout clean, and the hover interaction invites exploration, so visitors reach educational content and deeper pages sooner. Answering common questions early reduces uncertainty and nudges hesitant visitors toward product or category pages. The large lifestyle image adds emotional appeal.

how.text: Build as a custom Shopify section with up to 5 blocks. Each block has a number, title, short description, link label and URL, and an optional image. On desktop, hovering a row (mouseenter) expands that row with a CSS height/opacity transition and collapses the others. The first or a default row can start open. On mobile there is no hover, so use tap-to-expand accordion behaviour. The left image is a static panel in the screenshot. Swapping the image per hovered topic is plausible and likely what the video shows, but this is an assumption. Keep rows accessible with button/aria-expanded and keyboard focus support.

items: Blocks (up to 5): title, short description, link label ('Learn more'), link URL
Optional per-block image, swapped in the left panel on hover (unverified)

dependencies.text: No apps required. Needs a custom section with blocks (Liquid, CSS, light JS). The linked guide/FAQ pages or blog articles must exist. Image assets per topic are optional. The reference video attached in Asana should be reviewed to confirm the exact hover and image-swap behaviour.

items: Click-through rate on the 'Learn more' links
Homepage bounce rate and scroll depth to the section
Click-through to guide/FAQ and collection pages
Assisted conversion from guide content visitors

images.caption: Samsung reference: headline, large image panel left, numbered topic list right, with topic 05 expanded showing description and underlined 'Learn more' link under a divider line.
Layout of numbered rows, divider and expanded content to replicate in section blocks.
